The maximum credit limit is $1,900, the total household resources limit is $71,500, phase-out begins when total household resources exceed $62,500, and the maximum taxable value is $165,400.

## Definition of Total Household Resources

Beginning in 2012, "household income" as used in Chapter 9 of the Michigan Income Tax Act relating to the home heating and homestead property tax credits was replaced with "total household resources," which are defined as all income received by all persons of a household in a tax year while members of a household, increased by certain deductions from federal gross income.
